observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A television stage set designed to look like an Irish pub called 'The Celtic Tap', featuring a wooden floor, tables, chairs, bar counter, and background lighting.
observation.dancers: A large mixed group of men and women, appearing to be professional dancers, performing as couples and as a group.
observation.formation_and_space: Dynamic group formations shifting between pairs dancing across the floor, dancers standing or dancing on top of tables and the bar counter, and synchronized lines.
observation.posture: Upright and energetic torso posture with flexible, bent knees and weight shifting actively between feet.
observation.footwork: Rapid rhythmic stepping, heel clicks, leaps, and traveling steps coordinated with fast percussive sounds.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held in various positions including open out to the sides, hands on hips, clasped with partners, or gesturing dynamically in the air.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright with energetic movement, spinning and turning with lively dynamic shifts.
observation.partnering: Couples hold each other with standard and open ballroom-style holds, spinning, lifting, and dipping each other.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: High jumps, leaps, rapid turns, spinning, and brief moments dropping to the floor or kneeling.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear white shirts, dark trousers, and suspenders, some with waistcoats; women wear white blouses with skirts in blue, purple, or green, and dark boots. Tables, chairs, and bar furniture serve as elevated surfaces.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot articulation and individual weight distribution cannot be determined due to rapid choreography and camera cuts.

signature_moments.what: Dancers perform rapid foot-tapping sequences while moving across the floor in open posture.
A male dancer leaps high onto the bar counter while others cheer and clap below.
Dancers execute synchronized rapid footwork while dropping to one knee on the floor.
Dancers on the bar counter perform synchronized high kicks while partners dance below.
